method: scripts/quality/audit-item-counts.py seeds each list app at 0, 1, 20 and 100 items with ~70-character accented-Latin titles (CJK and emoji exceed the simulator face), renders the list screen at clara-bw-391 default scale, and screenshots every count. Seeding writes the app store or shelf format directly, or drives the companion CLI where one exists for the sim (vault, frame).
caps: todo 60 items, rss 40 feeds, panels 64 books: over-cap inputs are clamped or rejected cleanly, never crash
